marks.gloss_en: והתניא: פנימי סמוך לבשר
אמר רב אחא אמר רב כהנא: איקלודי מיקליד -- it bores [into the flesh] (= p_ikludei_mikalid)
a baraita: the inner is next to the flesh
והא תניא: חיצון הסמוך לעצם
היכא דפרעי טבחי -- where the butchers open it (= p_heicha_defari_tabachei)
a baraita: the outer is next to the bone
והלכתא כרב אחא לקולא -- in these three
throughout the Torah Ravina is lenient and Rav Acha stringent, and the halakha is like Ravina leniently -- except these three
והלכתא: להלקותו בכזית
לעברו בכשעורה
Mar Zutra: a barley-grain in one place
the one who forbids: since they do not heal, they are a limb from the living
and the other [who forbids]: that they do not rot is because the air does not reach them
R' Yochanan to Rav Shemen bar Abba: but you shall not eat them, on account of 'and do not forsake the teaching of your mother' (Prov 1:8)
Mar bar Rav Ashi: kid's testicles, until thirty days, are permitted without peeling
raw meat that reddened: if one cut and salted it, even for the pot it is fine
a head in the ashes, set on the place of slaughter: the blood drips and it is permitted
set on its sides with something inserted: permitted
Shmuel: there are two nerves; the inner is next to the bone
Rav Yehuda: a butcher after whom fat was found -- [liable] at a barley-grain
Rav Pappa: they do not disagree; here [R' Yochanan's olive-bulk] -- to flog him
אכשור דרי? -- have the later generations improved, that butchers once not believed are now believed?
מעיקרא דהוו סברי לה כרבי מאיר לא הוו מהימני, ולבסוף סברי כרבי יהודה -- the change is in the ruling followed, not in the butchers (= p_meikara_kerm_levasof_kery)

at first, when they held like R' Meir, they were not believed; at the end they held like R' Yehuda [Steinsaltz: R' Yehuda does not require scraping after the roots, so the work is easy and they are believed]
אכשור דרי? -- [after the reversal to 'not believed'] have the generations improved, that now they are believed?
at first they held like R' Yehuda, then they held like R' Meir [hence R' Yochanan's reversal to 'not believed']
מעיקרא סברוה כרבי יהודה, הדר סברוה כרבי מאיר; כמה דהוו דכירי לה לדרבי יהודה לא מהימני, והשתא דאינשיוה מהימני (= p_meikara_kery_hadar_kerm, p_inshyuha_lidry)
as long as they remembered R' Yehuda's [view] they were not believed; now that they have forgotten R' Yehuda's [view] they are believed [hence Rav Nachman's 'nowadays']
R' Yochanan: they reversed and said: [butchers] are believed [about the sciatic nerve]
R' Yochanan (on the Sages' clause): they reversed and said: [butchers] are not believed
a person may send a gentile a thigh with the sciatic nerve inside it
חלב, מאן דכר שמיה? -- R' Meir's clause spoke only of the sciatic nerve; who mentioned fat, that the Sages say 'and about the fat'?
הכי קאמר: אין נאמנין עליו ועל החלב, וחכמים אומרים: נאמנין עליו ועל החלב (= p_hachi_kaamar_chelev)
read thus, R' Meir says: they are not believed about it [the nerve] or about the fat
שלמה אין, חתוכה לא -- read off the mishna's 'because its place is recognisable'
stam: [the mishna permits a thigh] whole -- yes; cut -- no
